title: The Ember of the Ninefold Court
author: Noor Oyelaran
blurb: Lena Reyes, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
